representation.name: H5AD index samples
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
{
  printf 'OBS_INDEX_FIRST_200\n'
  h5dump -d /obs/_index -s 0 -c 200 "$(inputs.input.path)"
  printf '\nOBS_INDEX_LAST_200\n'
  h5dump -d /obs/_index -s 19872 -c 200 "$(inputs.input.path)"
  printf '\nVAR_INDEX_FIRST_120\n'
  h5dump -d /var/_index -s 0 -c 120 "$(inputs.input.path)"
  printf '\nGENE_SYMBOL_CATEGORIES_FIRST_120\n'
  h5dump -d /var/gene_symbols/categories -s 0 -c 120 "$(inputs.input.path)"
} > index_samples.txt
